content.short: Blizzard Fund is a $200M+ venture fund supporting growth and innovation in the Avalanche ecosystem and beyond.
content.description: Blizzard Fund backs early-stage ventures, including those raising Seed and Series A rounds, and occasionally takes a lead in deals while coordinating with other funds to secure the resources a startup needs for success. An investment from Blizzard is more than capital; the fund works in close partnership with Ava Labs and collaborators to offer co-marketing, business development, and access to engineering support. Its global team of experienced blockchain entrepreneurs leverages real-world experience to advise on governance and strategic decision making.
